text: NIKÉ, spol. s r.o. is a private limited liability company (Slovak sro) whose partners are three individuals: MUDr. Robert Mardiak (deposit 510,000 EUR), Adriana Borutová (323,000 EUR) and Ing. Roman Berger (867,000 EUR), per the commercial register of the City Court Bratislava III.
short: Niké is a private Slovak company owned by three individuals (Mardiak, Borutová, Berger).

source.name: Slovak Commercial Register (orsr.sk) — extract for N I K É, spol. s r.o., City Court Bratislava III, Oddiel Sro, vložka 309/B
source.quote: Partners: MUDr. Robert Mardiak Date of birth: 08/06/1942 (from: 02/17/2021) Adriana Borut
source.note: The register extract's 'Legal form: Private limited liability company' line and the full partners block (Mardiak, Borutová, Berger, with deposits of 510,000 / 323,000 / 867,000 EUR of 1,700,000 EUR share capital and no state or state-fund shareholder) support the claim. The quote is truncated where the page's encoding drops accented characters (Borutová); the same page text continues 'Ing. Roman Berger Date of birth: 07/24/1965'.
